character: Fictional circuit set in and around the mountain town of Hakone, Japan, winding up and down serpentine mountain roads for over 10 miles at full length. Elevation change and blind, technical corners dominate; no individual corners have established community names.
notes: Community knowledge (no formal corner-name guide available). Character based on official Forza track-list description; no individual corners have established community names.

corners.name: Turn 1
corners.type: medium-speed corner off the front straight
corners.trap: Running wide compromises the run into the following section

corners.name: Turn 6
corners.type: fast, blind corner on a mountain climb
corners.technique: Commit through the blind section, trust the line
corners.trap: Lifting unnecessarily on the blind entry costs significant time

corners.name: Turn 12
corners.type: tight, technical hairpin on a descent
corners.technique: Patient braking on the downhill approach, low-speed precision
corners.trap: Misjudging braking distance on the steep descent

corners.name: Final Corner
corners.technique: Late apex, clean exit is critical — feeds the front straight
corners.trap: Compromised exit costs time down the entire straight
